storySection.paragraph1: Stocking up for a get-together? Picking a gift? Or simply finding your favorite bottle? Stop by JFK Liquors and explore at your own pace.
storySection.paragraph2: You'll find us on John F Kennedy Boulevard, near George Bush Intercontinental Airport in Houston. Ask our team for help choosing what to take home.

contactPage.subtitle: Conveniently located on John F Kennedy Blvd, Suite D, minutes from IAH terminals. Free parking on-site.

aboutPage.paragraph2: Whether you are picking up a bottle on your way home, stocking up for a weekend gathering, or shopping for a gift, we provide a clean, welcoming store with a straightforward retail shopping experience.
aboutPage.card3Text: Quick in-and-out access on JFK Boulevard near IAH airport terminals with free storefront parking right outside Suite D.
aboutPage.paragraph3: Our shelves are stocked with a broad selection of sealed spirits, wines, beers, and mixers — including bourbon and American whiskey, Scotch, tequila and mezcal, vodka, gin, rum, cognac, red and white wines, champagne, and cold craft and imported beer.
aboutPage.leadParagraph: Conveniently located at 15655 John F Kennedy Boulevard, Suite D — just minutes from George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) — JFK Liquors is a neighborhood retail liquor store serving local Houston residents, visitors, and travelers.
aboutPage.card2Text: Our store team is always glad to help you find a specific bottle on our shelves or choose a great option for your occasion.
aboutPage.card1Text: We carry a wide variety of popular national brands, Texas favorites, and special-occasion bottles across spirits, wine, and cold beer.
